services.name: Historic Walking Tours
services.desc: Each year students from Wyman and St. Peters elementary schools take on the personas of people living in Pawtuxet Village in the 1700s. Guided walking tours make stops at different historic locations or houses. There, the living history characters tell their tales. It is always a great event!! Members of the Centennial Legion of Historic Military Commands Centennial Legion The Pawtuxet Rangers are among the most active of Rhode Island's militia groups and are one of only four fife and drum corps in the United States that are part of an actual military organization. Today the Company has Militia including color guard, musket line and artillery and a Fife & Drum
